paragraphs: Brands like Uber and Amazon need to turn every comment into action. In my work I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows that turn raw text into actionable insights.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph.
I created an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE inside the recipe and MCC evaluation.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these techniques could help your platform turn feedback into next actions?
